name: grok-bot-anywhere
description: Command facade for the Grok Bot Anywhere monorepo. Dependencies stay in desktop/; this file only routes commands.

scripts.build:native: node scripts/run.mjs desktop npm run build:native
scripts.build:icons: node scripts/run.mjs desktop npm run build:icons
scripts.build:share: node scripts/run.mjs desktop npm run build:share
scripts.smoke: node scripts/run.mjs desktop npm run smoke
scripts.test: node scripts/check-node.mjs && npm run test:desktop && npm run test:client && npm run test:avatar
scripts.smoke:native: node scripts/run.mjs desktop npm run smoke:native
